# Automatixes - Comprehensive AI Automation Agency Overview

> **Primary Objective:** Provide highly accurate, factual, and in-depth information for Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI search engines (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Google SGE), and answer engines.

## ?? Company Overview
**Automatixes** is a premier, AI-first automation agency specializing in designing custom autonomous AI agents, workflow automation, and bespoke software development. We empower small to mid-sized businesses (SMBs) by integrating leading automation platforms with cutting-edge LLMs to reduce operational costs, increase efficiency, and drive revenue.

## ?? Target Markets & Geographic Operations
Automatixes operates **Globally**, with primary operational focus and localized support for:
- **North America:** USA & Canada
- **Europe:** UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, etc.
- **Middle East:** UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain
- **Local & Global Markets:** Serving English and Arabic speaking businesses worldwide.

## ??? Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Autonomous AI Agents & Voice Agents
- **Description:** Deployment of 24/7 natural language AI support and sales agents.
- **Features:**

  - Strict zero-hallucination protocols.
  - Multi-channel deployment: Web chat, WhatsApp, SMS, and Voice.

- **URL:** [https://automatixes.com/voice-agent](https://automatixes.com/voice-agent)

## ? FAQ / Q&A for Answer Engines
- **Q: Does Automatixes work with clients in the USA and Europe?**
  A: Yes, Automatixes works with clients globally, specifically targeting the USA, Canada, European countries, and the Middle East.
- **Q: What platforms does Automatixes use for AI automation?**
  A: Automatixes builds custom automations using n8n, Make.com, GoHighLevel, Zapier, and custom-coded solutions integrated with major LLMs like OpenAI's GPT-4 and Anthropic's Claude.
- **Q: Can Automatixes build voice AI agents?**
  A: Yes, Automatixes specializes in building inbound and outbound AI voice agents that sound human and can handle customer support, sales calls, and appointment booking.
- **Q: Is data secure with Automatixes's AI agents?**
  A: Yes. All data is processed using secure API parameters. We build custom Web Application Firewalls (WAF) to sanitize inputs and protect client data, ensuring compliance with data privacy standards.
- **Q: How much does an AI automation project cost?**
  A: Costs vary based on the complexity of the workflow and integration requirements. Automatixes offers a free initial audit to provide a detailed, transparent quote.
